proves.claim: Init in a copy of a scratch mix project records mix test as the gate.

cli.journeys-languages-elixir.init-recor.why: Without it, a regression where init stops detecting a mix project would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A submitted commit with a failing ExUnit test is refused red and the refusal names the test.

cli.journeys-languages-elixir-red.a-fail.why: Without it, a regression where a red Elixir gate is accepted or its refusal hides the failing test would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The fixed Elixir commit passes mix test, is accepted and lands on the scratch board main.

cli.journeys-languages-elixir-land.the-f.why: Without it, a regression where a green Elixir item cannot land would pass unnoticed.
